policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Cal State LA lead the division's unbeaten sides on wins Cal State LA beat Menlo and are still without a defeat, and no other unbeaten programme in the division has won as many matches. Lincoln and Emory & Henry also won and stay unbeaten; Midwestern State are the only other programme yet to lose.
